A '''captain''' commanded a [[Unidentified passenger liner|passenger liner]], and was present when it was [[Unidentified pirate raid|attacked]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] sometime after the start of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The captain hailed the nearby ''[[Far Orbit]]'', thinking it was an Imperial escort frigate, and the ship saved them from the pirates.
